title: Synchronous third-party widgets on render
summary: Templates or extensions block page rendering on third-party scripts or API calls.
rationale: Blocking external dependencies add latency, resilience risk, and avoidable network work.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Defer noncritical widgets, cache server-side enrichment, and use async loading patterns.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
